content:
Forlinx OK8275AA-C is an industrial-grade single board computer (SBC) based on the company’s FET8275AA-C SoM, powered by a Qualcomm Dragonwing QCS8275 SoC, delivering up to 40 TOPS for Edge AI workloads, and paired with 12GB LPDDR5 memory and 256GB UFS 3.1 storage. While it’s based on the same processor as the Arduino VENTUNO Q SBC, the Forlinx OK8275AA-C SBC targets industrial applications with dual Ethernet (GbE + 2.5GbE), four isolated CAN-FD, 2x isolated RS485, three MIPI CSI camera connectors, a MIPI DSI display connector, a -40 to +85°C temperature range, and 24V DC power input. Forlinx FET8275AA-C – A Qualcomm QCS8275 system-on-module Before checking the SBC in detail, let’s have a look at the system-on-module first. FET8275AA-C specifications: SoC – Qualcomm Dragonwing QCS8275-AA (highest performance, as opposed to QCS8275-AC with lower CPU and GPU frequency and only 20 TOPS AI) Octa-core CPU 2x Kryo Gold Prime (Cortex-A78) @ 2.35 GHz [...]
